children.value: > Fact From Story: In a sudden late announcement, OpenAI revealed that it and Altman “have reached an agreement in principle” for him to return as the company’s CEO.
> > Fact From Story: Altman also posted about the new deal, giving some insight into the roller coaster that we’ve all been riding since his firing was revealed Friday.

> > > Fact From Story: In a dramatic turn of events late Friday, ex-Y Combinator president Sam Altman was fired as CEO of AI startup OpenAI, the company behind viral AI hits like ChatGPT, GPT-4 and DALL-E 3, by OpenAI’s board of directors.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Being fired from a job means your services are no longer needed or wanted.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: CEOs usually have a vision for a company, and implement changes to realize that vision.

> Fact From Story: After the leadership shake-up in November, OpenAI is going to be a changed company — perhaps not outwardly, but the trickle-down effect of Sam Altman being more fully in charge will be felt at every level.
> > Fact From Story: Expect more moves like that from 2024’s OpenAI as the caution and academic reserve that the previous board exerted gives way to an unseemly lust for markets and customers.
> > > Fact From Story: In a sudden late announcement, OpenAI revealed that it and Altman “have reached an agreement in principle” for him to return as the company’s CEO.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: CEOs have significant influence over the direction of a company.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: New leadership often brings changes in strategy and priorities.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A company's direction can change with a new CEO.
